## `mpx setup`

- `mpx setup` — Install and configure MPX for this user.

## `mpx doctor`

Diagnose project configuration and services.

- `mpx doctor` — Diagnose project configuration and services.

## `mpx init`

Initialize an MPX project.

- `mpx init` — Initialize an MPX project.

## `mpx launch`

Start a native runtime with MPX routing and content.

### `mpx launch pi [options]`

Launch Pi.

### `mpx launch claude [options]`

Launch Claude.

## `mpx content`

Inspect and verify the active compiled content projection.

### `mpx content inspect [<skill|agent> <identity>]`

Inspect the active projection or print one exact compiled file.

### `mpx content check`

Verify all active compiler files.

## `mpx issue`

Work with provider-neutral issues.

### `mpx issue list [--state open|finished]`

List issues.

### `mpx issue view --id <id>`

View an issue.

Examples:

- `mpx issue view --id 123`

### `mpx issue create --title <title> --body <body>`

Create an issue.

### `mpx issue edit --id <id> --title <title> --body <body>`

Edit an issue.

### `mpx issue comment --id <id> --body <body>`

Comment on an issue.

### `mpx issue finish --id <id>`

Finish an issue.

## `mpx review`

Work with provider-neutral code reviews.

### `mpx review view --id <id>`

View a review.

### `mpx review create --title <title> --body <body> --source-branch <branch> --target-branch <branch>`

Create a review.

### `mpx review merge --id <id> [--method merge|squash|rebase]`

Merge a review.

## `mpx ci`

Inspect and control provider-neutral CI.

### `mpx ci status --id <id>`

Show CI status.

### `mpx ci logs --run-id <id>`

Show CI run logs.

## `mpx session`

List and resume native runtime sessions.

### `mpx session list [options]`

List sessions.

### `mpx session resume <id> [options]`

Resume one session.

Examples:

- `mpx session resume abc123`

## `mpx workspace`

Inspect and manage project workspaces.

### `mpx workspace list`

List workspaces.

### `mpx workspace show [path] [--machine]`

Show a workspace.

### `mpx workspace create <branch> [options]`

Create a workspace.

### `mpx workspace remove <path>`

Remove a workspace.

### `mpx workspace start <service-id> [path]`

Start a configured service.

### `mpx workspace stop <service-id> [path]`

Stop a configured service.

### `mpx workspace logs <service-id> [path] [--lines <count>]`

Show configured service logs.

## `mpx port`

Manage verified port listeners.

### `mpx port kill <pid>`

Kill a verified listener by PID.
